ns2:course.label: OR Models for Mfg Systems
ns2:course.description: Operations research techniques applied to problems in manufacturing and distribution. Single and multi-stage lot sizing problems, scheduling and sequencing problems, and performance evaluation of manufacturing systems. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: IE 310.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: IE 310.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
